RUN 2026-08-16. Verdict was DECIDED_BY_PILOT and came back PASS_SYNTHETIC_GATE: 1% lower bound 0.1202 against the 0.10 threshold. Numerics dominates its variance (3.8e-4 vs 3.3e-6 transport) and the effect still differs 22% between mesh factors (0.1236 at f=1, 0.1513 at f=2) — but the distribution does not STRADDLE the threshold, so the decision is resolution-robust even though the magnitude is not converged. A dominant variance source does not by itself make a verdict indeterminate.
